source_copy: Physical copy of complete source and Git metadata; no links to original.
measurements: Full original/copy source and Git hashes before/after; private data separately snapshotted and hashed.
guards: Deny network and original writes in Python/child processes; disposable copies may mutate. Windows extended path spellings normalize before boundary checks.
limitations: Not a native-code operating-system sandbox. Derived workflow copy commits are separately identified, never called Git-byte-identical.
